page.layout: One printed page (page 17), a calendar table. Running head at the top, with a Hebrew month line beneath it. Below: a table of three columns. Left: Gregorian dates with month names and dominical letters. Centre: Dies numbers and Jewish day names with the month heading. Right: notes beside the rows. main_text.l: 1637. | | 8. IIAR di. 29. | Secundus in anno sacro. Character ejus hoc anno. 6. 18. 855.
24 | 10 | Iejunium. | Die 10. moritur Eli Pontifex maximus, & ambo filii ejus. Capitur arca testimonii. 1. Sam. 4.
12 | 28 | Iejunium. | Die 28. moritur Samuel Propheta. Plangitur ab omni populo. 1. Sam. 25.

page.notes: The table is printed with rules; the cells are separated by " | ". The right-hand notes stand beside the rows for 24 and 28 and are given in the rows. The top right note "Secundus in anno sacro" and the dates in the left column are printed in italic and roman as shown. The ghost text of the facing page is show-through and omitted.
